mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.board_title AS boardTitle, b.board_content AS boardContent, i.image_file_url AS thumbnailImageUrl, u.nickname AS nickname, b.view_count AS viewCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `comment` c WHERE c.board_id = b.board_id ) AS commentCount, 0 AS likeCount, 0 AS dislikeCount, b.board_created_at AS createdAt, b.modified_at AS modifiedAt FROM board b JOIN users u ON b.user_id = u.users_id LEFT JOIN image_file i ON i.image_file_id = ( SELECT MIN(ii.image_file_id) FROM image_file ii WHERE ii.board_id = b.board_id ) WHERE b.board_status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY b.board_created_at DESC, b.board_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board WHERE board_status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET board_status = #{status}, board_status_updated_at = NOW() WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
